verdict.rationale: The evidence shows internal classification features: categories, cost centers, suppliers, and transaction reconciliation through the API. Nothing documents syncing transactions to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, or mapping them to GL accounts, classes, or departments in those systems. The internal tagging is an adjacent feature, and the generic API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit toward an accounting-sync story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control
